hadith:
Prostration - Narrated by 'Ata' bin Yasar -  Volume 2, Book 19, Number 178 

I asked Zaid bin Thabit about prostration on which he said that he had recited An-Najm before the Prophet, yet he (the Prophet) had not performed a prostration.
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Qawiyy - الْقَوِيُّ - The Possessor of all strength

The name Al Qawiyy emphasizes the unmatched strength and power of Allah, highlighting that He is capable of doing all things without any limitations. This name originates from the Arabic root 'q-w-y', which signifies strength and might. Al Qawiyy reminds believers of the importance of relying on Allah's strength during times of difficulty.
verse:
Al-Ahzab - The Combined Forces - 33:45-46

O Prophet! We have sent you as a witness, and a deliverer of good news, and a warner, and a caller to ˹the Way of˺ Allah by His command, and a beacon of light.
